subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：1,3-Dioxolane（ethylene acetal or ketal）？
A. HCl, THF/H₂O
B. DIBAL-H, CH₂Cl₂, −78 °C
C. N₂H₄·H₂O, EtOH, heat
D. Pd(PPh₃)₄, PhSiH₃
explanation: Protects an aldehyde or ketone as a cyclic acetal; stable to base, nucleophiles and hydrides, aqueous acid removes it. Aqueous acid hydrolyses the acetal back to the carbonyl.
